words.enDefinition: an app's authorisation to send alerts through the device system

examples.en: The timetable app asked for notification permission before sending alerts about class changes.
examples.zh: 课表应用在发送课程变更提醒前先请求了「通知权限」。

examples.en: I checked whether the calendar app still had notification permission on my tablet.
examples.zh: 我检查日历应用在平板上是否仍有「通知权限」。

words.enDefinition: gives an app permission to show alerts on your device

examples.en: I chose "Allow notifications" because I needed updates from the course app.
examples.zh: 我需要课程应用发来的更新，所以选择了「允许通知」。

examples.en: The "Allow notifications" toggle was off for the app we use in class.
examples.zh: 我们上课用的应用没有打开「允许通知」开关。

words.enDefinition: to stop an app from showing alerts through the device system

examples.en: I decided to turn off app notifications for a game I rarely played anymore.
examples.zh: 我决定给一款已经很少玩的游戏「关闭应用通知」。

examples.en: My roommate wanted to turn off app notifications while keeping the app on her phone.
examples.zh: 室友想「关闭应用通知」，同时把应用留在手机里。

collocations: decide to turn off app notifications
option to turn off app notifications
turn off app notifications at night

words.enDefinition: device settings that control which alerts appear and how they behave

examples.en: I opened the system notification settings to check why my apps had gone quiet.
examples.zh: 我打开「系统通知设置」，看看为什么应用都没了提示音。

examples.en: The course app links to system notification settings for changes affecting every alert type.
examples.zh: 要改所有类型的提醒，课程应用会跳转到「系统通知设置」。

words.enDefinition: a group of alerts of one kind sent by an app

examples.en: My phone lets me adjust each notification category for the calendar app separately.
examples.zh: 我的手机可以分别调整日历应用的每个「通知类别」。

examples.en: The campus app had a separate notification category for timetable changes that term.
examples.zh: 那学期，校园应用有一个专门用于课表变更的「通知类别」。

words.enDefinition: an on-screen strip that displays an alert over other content

examples.en: A notification banner appeared while I was reading a paper on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我正在笔记本电脑上读论文时，弹出了一条「横幅通知」。

examples.en: I saw the notification banner before the alert disappeared from the screen again.
examples.zh: 提醒又从屏幕上消失前，我看到了那条「横幅通知」。

words.enDefinition: a banner that disappears from the screen automatically after appearing

examples.en: I chose a temporary banner so the alert would disappear on its own.
examples.zh: 我选了「临时横幅」，提醒就会自己消失。

examples.en: The reminder appeared as a temporary banner while I was editing my essay.
examples.zh: 我在改论文时，提醒以「临时横幅」的形式出现。

words.enDefinition: a banner that remains visible until it is dismissed or opened

examples.en: A persistent banner covered the top of my screen until I dismissed it.
examples.zh: 「持续显示的横幅」一直挡着屏幕上方，直到我把它关掉。

examples.en: I picked a persistent banner for changes to the laboratory schedule.
examples.zh: 我为实验室课表变更选了「持续显示的横幅」。

words.enDefinition: an alert shown while the device's screen is locked

examples.en: A lock screen notification reminded me to return the library book that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，一条「锁屏通知」提醒我还图书馆的书。

examples.en: I noticed the lock screen notification before unlocking my phone after class.
examples.zh: 下课后解锁手机前，我注意到了那条「锁屏通知」。

words.enDefinition: a small portion of a message or event shown with an alert

examples.en: I could read the first few words in the notification preview.
examples.zh: 我能在「通知内容预览」里看到开头几个词。

examples.en: The notification preview showed a different room number for the seminar.
examples.zh: 「通知内容预览」显示研讨课换了教室。

words.enDefinition: conceals private details in notifications displayed on a locked screen

examples.en: I selected "Hide sensitive content" before lending my phone to a classmate.
examples.zh: 我把手机借给同学前，选择了「隐藏敏感内容」。

examples.en: The lock screen setting let me hide sensitive content while keeping alert icons visible.
examples.zh: 锁屏设置允许我「隐藏敏感内容」，同时保留提醒图标。

collocations: hide sensitive content on your lock screen

words.enDefinition: allows details of an alert to appear after unlocking

examples.en: I chose to show previews when unlocked instead of seeing messages on the lock screen.
examples.zh: 我选择「解锁后显示通知预览」，锁屏上就不用直接显示消息。

examples.en: My tablet can show previews when unlocked while leaving alert icons visible beforehand.
examples.zh: 我的平板可以「解锁后显示通知预览」，解锁前仍显示提醒图标。

collocations: choose to show previews when unlocked
prefer to show previews when unlocked
set alerts to show previews when unlocked

words.enDefinition: a small dot on an app icon indicating an alert

examples.en: I noticed a notification dot on the reading app after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，我看到阅读应用上有个「通知提示点」。

examples.en: The notification dot appeared on my calendar icon when something changed.
examples.zh: 日历有更新时，图标上出现了「通知提示点」。

words.enDefinition: the number displayed in a badge on an app icon

examples.en: I saw the badge count rise while I worked on the essay.
examples.zh: 我写论文的时候，看见「角标数字」变大了。

examples.en: The badge count beside the mail icon didn't match my unread messages.
examples.zh: 邮件图标旁的「角标数字」和未读消息数对不上。

words.enDefinition: a setting that puts related alerts together on the screen

examples.en: I changed notification grouping so one app wouldn't fill the whole screen.
examples.zh: 我改了「通知分组」设置，避免一个应用把整块屏幕占满。

examples.en: The sample screenshot shows how notification grouping keeps the list shorter.
examples.zh: 示例截图显示，「通知分组」可以缩短列表。

words.enDefinition: a layered display combining several alerts in one part of the screen

examples.en: I opened a notification stack to read several updates from the campus app.
examples.zh: 我打开一组「叠放的通知」，查看校园应用的几条更新。

examples.en: The notification stack kept the lock screen tidy during our group project.
examples.zh: 做小组项目期间，「叠放的通知」让锁屏看起来更整洁。

words.enDefinition: to open an alert further so more details become visible

examples.en: I had to expand a notification before I could read the room number.
examples.zh: 我得先「展开一条通知」，才能看到教室号。

examples.en: The tablet let me expand a notification without opening the course app.
examples.zh: 我的平板能「展开一条通知」，不用打开课程应用。

words.enDefinition: a system panel where recent alerts are collected for viewing

examples.en: I checked the notification centre after I finished presenting the slides.
examples.zh: 讲完幻灯片后，我查看了「通知中心」。

examples.en: The notification centre held several updates about our change of classroom.
examples.zh: 「通知中心」里有几条关于我们换教室的更新。

words.enDefinition: the Android dropdown panel showing alerts and sometimes quick settings

examples.en: I pulled down the notification shade on Android to check a timetable change.
examples.zh: 我在 Android 手机上打开「下拉通知面板」，查看课表有没有变。

examples.en: The notification shade showed the notice from my language class at the top.
examples.zh: 「下拉通知面板」顶部显示了语言课的通知。

collocations: read alerts in the notification shade

words.enDefinition: a list of alerts that appeared earlier on your device

examples.en: I found the lecture update in notification history after dismissing it.
examples.zh: 关闭那条大课更新后，我又在「通知历史记录」里找到了它。

examples.en: My phone's notification history showed what arrived while I was in class.
examples.zh: 手机上的「通知历史记录」显示了我上课时收到的提醒。

words.enDefinition: to remove an alert from its display without opening it

examples.en: I meant to dismiss a notification, but I opened the app instead.
examples.zh: 我本来想「划掉一条通知」，却点进了应用。

examples.en: You can dismiss a notification after reading its first sentence on the screen.
examples.zh: 在屏幕上看完第一句话后，可以「划掉一条通知」。

words.enDefinition: to remove all removable alerts from the current list at once

examples.en: I wanted to clear all notifications after checking the updated lecture times twice.
examples.zh: 我把新的上课时间核对两遍后，想「清除全部通知」。

examples.en: The phone displayed an option to clear all notifications below the list.
examples.zh: 手机在列表下方显示了「清除全部通知」选项。

words.enDefinition: to hide an alert temporarily and have it return later

examples.en: I chose to snooze a notification about my book return until after class.
examples.zh: 我选择先「暂缓图书还书通知」，下课后再提醒。

examples.en: You can snooze a notification instead of opening it during your timed practice.
examples.zh: 如果正在计时练习，可以先「暂缓一条通知」，不用马上打开。

words.enDefinition: an alert kept visible while an associated activity is still running

examples.en: An ongoing notification showed that the lecture recording was still in progress.
examples.zh: 一条「持续任务通知」显示讲座录像还在继续。

examples.en: The ongoing notification disappeared once my audio app stopped playing in class.
examples.zh: 课上音频应用停止播放后，「持续任务通知」消失了。

words.enDefinition: an alert that appears without a sound or vibration

examples.en: I got a silent notification about the lab without disturbing anyone.
examples.zh: 我收到了有关实验课的「静音通知」，没打扰到别人。

examples.en: The calendar sent a silent notification while I was in the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆时，日历应用发来一条「静音通知」。

words.enDefinition: an audio signal played when an alert arrives

examples.en: I heard the notification sound while I was packing for the seminar.
examples.zh: 收拾东西准备去研讨课时，我听到了「通知提示音」。

examples.en: Our tablets used the same notification sound, so I checked the wrong one.
examples.zh: 我们的平板用了同一个「通知提示音」，结果我看错了设备。

words.enDefinition: a setting controlling when alerts are presented to the user

examples.en: I checked notification delivery after my course alerts arrived in batches.
examples.zh: 课程提醒一批一批送来后，我查看了「通知送达方式」。

examples.en: The phone showed two options for notification delivery in the settings.
examples.zh: 手机设置里显示了两种「通知送达方式」。

words.enDefinition: a setting that shows an alert as soon as it arrives

examples.en: I chose immediate delivery for the room changes sent by my university.
examples.zh: 我为学校发的教室变更提醒选了「通知即时送达」。

examples.en: The app's settings offered immediate delivery and a later batch for reminders.
examples.zh: 应用设置给提醒提供了「通知即时送达」和延后成批送达两种选择。

words.enDefinition: a setting that bundles selected notifications for delivery at chosen times

examples.en: I read the scheduled summary from several apps after my afternoon seminar.
examples.zh: 下午研讨课后，我读到了来自几个应用的「定时通知摘要」。

examples.en: The scheduled summary arrived while I was walking out of the library.
examples.zh: 我走出图书馆时，收到了「定时通知摘要」。

collocations: add apps to a scheduled summary

words.enDefinition: an alert marked for prompt delivery because its information may expire

examples.en: A time-sensitive notification warned that our assigned room had just changed.
examples.zh: 一条「时效性通知」提示，我们分到的教室刚刚变了。

examples.en: I noticed a time-sensitive notification about an update to my appointment time.
examples.zh: 我注意到一条关于预约时间变更的「时效性通知」。

words.enDefinition: a device mode that reduces distractions while you work

examples.en: I use focus mode when I need to finish a reading without interruptions.
examples.zh: 想不受打扰地读完材料时，我会用「专注模式」。

examples.en: My phone showed that focus mode was active during the morning lecture.
examples.zh: 手机显示，上午上大课时「专注模式」已开启。

words.enDefinition: an Apple Focus profile created with the user's own preferences

examples.en: I made a custom Focus for tutorials that use my phone for quizzes.
examples.zh: 有些辅导课要用手机答题，我为这些课建了个「自定义专注模式」。

examples.en: My iPhone had a custom Focus for the library and another for rehearsals.
examples.zh: 我的 iPhone 上有一个适合图书馆的「自定义专注模式」，另一个适合排练。

words.enDefinition: a schedule for automatically starting and ending a focus mode

examples.en: I edited my focus schedule after our lab moved to Friday mornings.
examples.zh: 实验课改到周五上午后，我改了「专注模式时间表」。

examples.en: My focus schedule started later on days when I had evening classes.
examples.zh: 有晚课的日子，我的「专注模式时间表」安排得更晚才启动。

words.enDefinition: to arrange for Do Not Disturb to start at certain times

examples.en: I decided to schedule Do Not Disturb on the days I have early lectures.
examples.zh: 我决定在有早课的那些日子「定时开启勿扰」。

examples.en: Can you schedule Do Not Disturb for different times on weekdays and at weekends?
examples.zh: 能不能分别给工作日和周末安排不同时间，「定时开启勿扰」？

collocations: choose to schedule Do Not Disturb
want to schedule Do Not Disturb

words.enDefinition: a duration option that keeps a mode active until manually stopped

examples.en: I selected "Until I turn it off" for a study session without a fixed ending.
examples.zh: 这次自习结束时间不定，所以我选了「直到我手动关闭」。

examples.en: My phone can stay in that mode until I turn it off after the workshop.
examples.zh: 工作坊结束后，手机可以保持这个模式，「直到我手动关闭」。

collocations: stay on until I turn it off
select until I turn it off
leave it active until I turn it off

words.enDefinition: to silence alerts temporarily for roughly sixty minutes

examples.en: I chose to mute for an hour so I could finish the practice exam.
examples.zh: 我选择「静音一小时」，好做完模拟卷。

examples.en: The alert menu offered an option to mute for an hour during my presentation.
examples.zh: 我做展示时，提醒菜单提供了「静音一小时」选项。

collocations: choose to mute for an hour
option to mute for an hour

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that a focus mode is currently silencing alerts

examples.en: My friend could see my focus status before sending another message.
examples.zh: 朋友在发下一条消息前，能看到我的「专注模式状态」。

examples.en: I checked the focus status shown beside my classmate's conversation.
examples.zh: 我看了看同学对话旁边显示的「专注模式状态」。

words.enDefinition: to let others see that your alerts are currently silenced

examples.en: I chose to share focus status so my group knew why replies might wait.
examples.zh: 我选择「共享专注状态」，这样组员知道我为什么可能晚点回消息。

examples.en: My iPhone let me share focus status for the schedule I use in seminars.
examples.zh: 我的 iPhone 可以为研讨课所用的模式「共享专注状态」。

collocations: decide whether to share focus status

words.enDefinition: a status saying someone has their notifications muted at present

examples.en: The conversation showed "Notifications silenced" beside my classmate's name that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，对话里同学的名字旁显示「通知已静音」。

examples.en: I saw "Notifications silenced" and saved my question for our next class.
examples.zh: 看到「通知已静音」后，我把问题留到了下次上课时再问。

words.enDefinition: an alert allowed to appear despite a mode limiting other notifications

examples.en: A priority notification reminded me about an upcoming tutorial during my focus session.
examples.zh: 专注时段里，一条「优先通知」提醒我辅导课快开始了。

examples.en: I saw a priority notification from the calendar while other banners were hidden.
examples.zh: 其他横幅都隐藏时，我看到了来自日历的一条「优先通知」。

words.enDefinition: a rule allowing specified alerts through when others are restricted

examples.en: I set a notification exception for the campus calendar during revision week.
examples.zh: 复习周期间，我给校园日历设了一个「通知例外」。

examples.en: My phone treated reminders from my list as a notification exception.
examples.zh: 我的手机把名单里的提醒当作「通知例外」处理。

words.enDefinition: apps whose alerts can still appear during a focus mode

examples.en: I checked the allowed apps because my timetable update still appeared.
examples.zh: 课表更新还是弹了出来，所以我查了「允许通知的应用」。

examples.en: The focus profile listed my calendar among the allowed apps that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，专注模式把日历列在「允许通知的应用」里。

words.enDefinition: people whose calls or messages may still alert you during focus

examples.en: I added my project partner to the allowed contacts for that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我把项目搭档加进了那天下午「允许提醒的联系人」名单。

examples.en: My phone showed who was on the list of allowed contacts.
examples.zh: 手机显示了谁在「允许提醒的联系人」名单上。

collocations: put someone among the allowed contacts

words.enDefinition: lets a later call from the same person ring through

examples.en: I saw allow repeat callers among the call options for my study profile.
examples.zh: 我在学习用专注模式的来电选项里看到了「允许重复来电」。

examples.en: The focus settings let you allow repeat callers while silencing some other calls.
examples.zh: 专注设置可以「允许重复来电」，同时静音其他一些电话。

collocations: decide whether to allow repeat callers

words.enDefinition: to let alarms sound while other alerts are being silenced

examples.en: I wanted my bedtime settings to allow alarms through even when calls were silent.
examples.zh: 我想让就寝设置在来电被静音时仍「允许闹钟响铃」。

examples.en: Her focus profile could allow alarms through while the rest of the device stayed quiet.
examples.zh: 她的专注模式可以「允许闹钟响铃」，设备其他提示仍保持安静。

collocations: set the mode to allow alarms through

words.enDefinition: an Apple setting choosing which app content is shown during focus

examples.en: I used a focus filter to show only the calendar for classes.
examples.zh: 我用了一个「专注模式筛选条件」，只显示上课用的日历。

examples.en: The focus filter hid my personal calendar while I worked on campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校忙时，「专注模式筛选条件」隐藏了个人日历。

collocations: use a focus filter for a calendar

words.enDefinition: to make selected apps temporarily unavailable to avoid distraction

examples.en: I use Android Focus mode to pause distracting apps when I'm doing practice questions.
examples.zh: 我做练习题时，用 Android 专注模式「暂停干扰专注的应用」。

examples.en: Could my device pause distracting apps until our group planning session is over?
examples.zh: 我能不能用设备「暂停干扰专注的应用」，直到小组计划会结束？

collocations: use focus mode to pause distracting apps

words.enDefinition: an app whose use and alerts have been paused temporarily

examples.en: The screen showed the game as a paused app during revision time.
examples.zh: 复习时，屏幕显示那款游戏是「已暂停的应用」。

examples.en: I couldn't open a paused app while my Android Focus mode was running.
examples.zh: Android 专注模式运行时，我打不开「已暂停的应用」。

words.enDefinition: to start using an app again after it was paused

examples.en: I could resume app use when my timed study period had ended.
examples.zh: 计时学习时段结束后，我可以「恢复使用应用」。

examples.en: My phone showed when I could resume app use after the quiz ended.
examples.zh: 小测结束后，手机显示了我什么时候能「恢复使用应用」。

words.enDefinition: a timed period for working with fewer digital distractions

examples.en: I started a focus session before drafting my part of the report.
examples.zh: 动笔写我负责的报告部分前，我开启了一个「专注时段」。

examples.en: My laptop showed how much time was left in the focus session.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑显示了这个「专注时段」还剩多少时间。

words.enDefinition: to stop a timed focus period before its planned ending

examples.en: I had to end a focus session early when our seminar room became available.
examples.zh: 研讨课教室空出来时，我不得不「提前结束专注时段」。

examples.en: My laptop offered to end a focus session early before the original timer ran out.
examples.zh: 原来的定时还没结束，电脑提供了「提前结束专注时段」的选项。

collocations: choose to end a focus session early
need to end a focus session early
option to end a focus session early

words.enDefinition: a timer showing how much time remains in a focus session

examples.en: The focus timer showed that I had time for one more question.
examples.zh: 「专注计时器」显示，我还有时间再做一题。

examples.en: I kept the focus timer visible while checking the last two references.
examples.zh: 核对最后两条参考文献时，我让「专注计时器」保持可见。

words.enDefinition: to conceal status marks on application icons in the taskbar

examples.en: I chose to hide taskbar badges during my timed writing practice on Windows.
examples.zh: 在 Windows 上做限时写作练习时，我选择「隐藏任务栏角标」。

examples.en: Focus could hide taskbar badges until my practice session came to an end.
examples.zh: 专注功能可以「隐藏任务栏角标」，直到练习时段结束。

words.enDefinition: repeated highlighting of a taskbar app icon to attract attention

examples.en: I noticed taskbar flashing when a classmate sent a chat message.
examples.zh: 同学发来聊天消息时，我注意到「任务栏图标闪烁」。

examples.en: My Windows focus session stopped the taskbar flashing while I finished writing.
examples.zh: 我写完之前，Windows 的专注时段阻止了「任务栏图标闪烁」。

words.enDefinition: an Android mode that limits interruptions around a planned bedtime

examples.en: My phone's bedtime mode started while I was putting my books away.
examples.zh: 我收书的时候，手机的「就寝模式」开启了。

examples.en: I scheduled bedtime mode earlier on nights before morning lab sessions.
examples.zh: 第二天一早要上实验课时，我把「就寝模式」设得早点开启。

words.enDefinition: an Apple Focus that limits interruptions around your scheduled sleep

examples.en: My iPhone was in sleep focus when my housemate sent a photo.
examples.zh: 室友发来一张照片时，我的 iPhone 处于「睡眠专注模式」。

examples.en: I checked whether sleep focus would start before our late train arrived.
examples.zh: 我看了看，深夜列车到站前「睡眠专注模式」会不会启动。

words.enDefinition: a bedtime setting that displays the screen without its colours

examples.en: I tried grayscale at bedtime and could still read my evening timetable.
examples.zh: 我试了「就寝时切换为灰度」，还是能看清晚上的课表。

examples.en: My phone offered grayscale at bedtime as part of its bedtime display options.
examples.zh: 手机把「就寝时切换为灰度」列为就寝显示选项之一。

words.enDefinition: an Android tool for reviewing and managing everyday device use

examples.en: I checked Digital Wellbeing to see which apps took the most time.
examples.zh: 我查看了「数字健康管理」，看哪些应用占用的时间最多。

examples.en: My phone has Digital Wellbeing options for making a bedtime schedule.
examples.zh: 我的手机有「数字健康管理」选项，可以安排就寝时间表。

words.enDefinition: a report on how much you used devices and apps

examples.en: My screen time report showed more reading time than I had expected.
examples.zh: 我的「屏幕使用时间报告」显示，阅读时间比我预想的长。

examples.en: I checked the screen time report before planning my next study week.
examples.zh: 安排下一周的学习前，我查看了「屏幕使用时间报告」。

words.enDefinition: the measuring and recording of time spent using a device

examples.en: I tried screen time tracking during the first week of my course.
examples.zh: 课程第一周，我试用了「屏幕时长统计」。

examples.en: The tablet had no old reports because screen time tracking was off.
examples.zh: 平板没有以前的报告，因为「屏幕时长统计」没开。

words.enDefinition: the Apple Screen Time feature that records app and website use

examples.en: My iPhone showed time on study websites under "App & Website Activity".
examples.zh: iPhone 在「应用与网站活动」下面显示了我访问学习网站的时长。

examples.en: The report was empty because "App & Website Activity" had not been switched on.
examples.zh: 报告是空的，因为「应用与网站活动」还没开启。

words.enDefinition: the combined duration of a person's activity on one device

examples.en: The chart compared my total time on device for different days of the week.
examples.zh: 图表对比了我一周中不同日子的「设备使用总时长」。

examples.en: My total time on device was higher on the day we had online classes.
examples.zh: 上网课那天，我的「设备使用总时长」更长。

words.enDefinition: the average amount of screen use per day over a period

examples.en: My average daily screen time dropped when our classes moved back to campus.
examples.zh: 课程改回线下以后，我的「平均每日屏幕时长」下降了。

examples.en: The weekly report displayed my average daily screen time below the graph.
examples.zh: 每周报告把我的「平均每日屏幕时长」显示在图表下面。

words.enDefinition: a graph showing device or app use for one day

examples.en: I opened the daily usage chart to look at the afternoon in detail.
examples.zh: 我打开「每日使用图表」，仔细看下午的情况。

examples.en: The daily usage chart showed a longer session during our online tutorial.
examples.zh: 「每日使用图表」显示，上网辅导课时有一段较长的使用记录。

words.enDefinition: a change or pattern in device use across several weeks

examples.en: I checked the weekly usage trend to compare midterms with quieter weeks.
examples.zh: 我查看「每周使用趋势」，对比期中考试周和课业较少的几周。

examples.en: My dashboard showed a weekly usage trend rather than just today's total.
examples.zh: 仪表板显示了「每周使用趋势」，也能看到今天以外的变化。

collocations: look at the weekly usage trend

words.zhGloss: 按类别统计的屏幕时长
words.enDefinition: device use time grouped by what kind of app was used
acceptedZhAnswers: 按类别统计的屏幕时长

examples.en: I compared screen time by category to see how much was course related.
examples.zh: 我对比了「按类别统计的屏幕时长」，看有多少和课程有关。

examples.en: The report displayed screen time by category, including games and reference tools.
examples.zh: 报告显示了「按类别统计的屏幕时长」，包括游戏和参考工具。

words.enDefinition: how long a user spent using applications individually

examples.en: I checked time spent in each app after a long afternoon of working on slides.
examples.zh: 改了很久的幻灯片后，我查了查「每个应用的使用时长」。

examples.en: My phone listed the time spent in each app over the course of a week.
examples.zh: 手机列出了一周内「每个应用的使用时长」。

collocations: track time spent in each app
show time spent in each app
check time spent in each app

words.enDefinition: the applications a person spent the most time using

examples.en: My most used apps changed during exams because I did more reading online.
examples.zh: 考试期间我在网上读的材料增多了，「使用最多的应用」也变了。

examples.en: I noticed my note editor among my most used apps this week.
examples.zh: 我注意到，笔记编辑器是这周我「使用最多的应用」之一。

words.enDefinition: a count of how often someone picks up a device

examples.en: My iPhone report listed device pickups at different times of the day.
examples.zh: iPhone 的报告列出了不同时段「拿起设备的次数」。

examples.en: The graph showed more device pickups between lectures than in the morning.
examples.zh: 图表显示，两堂课之间「拿起设备的次数」比上午更多。

words.enDefinition: the number of occasions when a device was unlocked

examples.en: My phone showed an unlock count for each day in the report.
examples.zh: 手机报告里每天都有一个「解锁次数」。

examples.en: I compared my unlock count on weekdays with the number on weekends.
examples.zh: 我比较了工作日和周末的「解锁次数」。

words.enDefinition: a usage statistic counting how many alerts the device received

examples.en: The report listed notifications received from each app during my morning lecture.
examples.zh: 报告列出了我上午上大课时各个应用「收到的通知数」。

examples.en: I compared notifications received with the number of times I checked my screen.
examples.zh: 我拿「收到的通知数」和自己看屏幕的次数对比了一下。

words.enDefinition: a record of how a device or its apps were used previously

examples.en: My usage history included the time I spent reading on the tablet.
examples.zh: 我的「使用记录」里有在平板上阅读的时长。

examples.en: I looked at last month's usage history to compare it with this week.
examples.zh: 我查了上个月的「使用记录」，想和这周比较。

words.enDefinition: the difference in a measurement between consecutive weeks

examples.en: The screen report showed the week-over-week change in my evening use.
examples.zh: 屏幕使用报告显示了我晚上用设备「较上周的变化」。

examples.en: I could see the week-over-week change after classes moved back into the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 课程改回大教室后，我就能看到「较上周的变化」。

words.zhGloss: 按设备统计的屏幕时长
words.enDefinition: the amount of screen use measured separately for each device
acceptedZhAnswers: 按设备统计的屏幕时长

examples.en: I checked screen time by device to separate my tablet use from my phone use.
examples.zh: 我查看了「按设备统计的屏幕时长」，把平板和手机的使用分开看。

examples.en: The report could show screen time by device, which helped during our online term.
examples.zh: 报告能显示「按设备统计的屏幕时长」，上网课的那个学期用得上。

words.enDefinition: an Apple setting that syncs Screen Time settings and reports

examples.en: I saw "Share Across Devices" while checking the screen time settings on my iPad.
examples.zh: 我在 iPad 上检查屏幕使用时间设置时看到了「跨设备共享」。

examples.en: With "Share Across Devices", my iPhone and tablet used the same limits.
examples.zh: 开启「跨设备共享」后，我的 iPhone 和平板使用同样的限制。

words.enDefinition: the total amount of screen use counted across multiple devices

examples.en: My combined screen time was longer once I included the tablet.
examples.zh: 把平板算进去以后，我的「合计屏幕使用时长」更长了。

examples.en: The report gave a combined screen time for the phone and the laptop.
examples.zh: 报告给出了手机和笔记本的「合计屏幕使用时长」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount of time a user is allowed to spend in an app within a set period

examples.en: I set an app time limit for games before revision week began.
examples.zh: 复习周开始前，我给游戏设了「应用使用时限」。

examples.en: My phone displayed the app time limit underneath the icon for that app.
examples.zh: 手机在那个应用的图标下面显示了「应用使用时限」。

words.enDefinition: the Apple Screen Time settings for limiting time in apps

examples.en: I found "App Limits" in the screen time settings on my iPhone.
examples.zh: 我在 iPhone 的屏幕使用时间设置里找到了「应用限额」。

examples.en: My tablet's "App Limits" menu listed separate options for games and other apps.
examples.zh: 我平板上的「应用限额」菜单分别列出了游戏和其他应用的选项。

collocations: check App Limits in Screen Time

words.enDefinition: an Android control that records how much time has been spent in an app and applies a daily limit

examples.en: I set an app timer for the app I kept opening during class.
examples.zh: 我给课上总会打开的那个应用设了「应用限时器」。

examples.en: The app timer had run out by the time I finished reading.
examples.zh: 我读完材料时，「应用限时器」的时间已经用完了。

words.enDefinition: an Android tool limiting time spent on a selected website

examples.en: I saw a site timer option beside the website in the usage report.
examples.zh: 我在使用报告里看到那个网站旁边有个「网站使用限时器」选项。

examples.en: I chose a site timer for one site instead of limiting the browser.
examples.zh: 我给一个网站设了「网站使用限时器」，没限制整个浏览器。

words.enDefinition: to set one time allowance for apps of the same kind

examples.en: My tablet can limit time by category for different sets of apps I use.
examples.zh: 我的平板可以给我用的不同应用「按应用类别限时」。

examples.en: I chose to limit time by category rather than setting every game separately.
examples.zh: 我选择「按应用类别限时」，不用逐一给每款游戏设限制。

collocations: choose to limit time by category
prefer to limit time by category
option to limit time by category

words.enDefinition: to choose separate schedules or usage limits for different weekdays

examples.en: I used "Customize days" to give weekends a different screen time schedule.
examples.zh: 我使用「自定各天安排」，给周末设了不同的屏幕使用时间计划。

examples.en: My phone let me customize days instead of applying the same limit daily.
examples.zh: 我的手机允许我「自定各天安排」，不用每天都用同一个限额。

collocations: customize days for an app limit

words.enDefinition: an alert that appears before a time allowance runs out

examples.en: A time limit warning appeared just before I finished the practice quiz.
examples.zh: 我快做完练习小测时，弹出一个「时限将到提醒」。

examples.en: I checked my notes after receiving the time limit warning on my tablet.
examples.zh: 平板收到「时限将到提醒」后，我看了看自己的笔记。

words.enDefinition: a message indicating an app's permitted usage time has run out

examples.en: The game showed "Time limit reached" after my evening of practice questions.
examples.zh: 晚上做完练习题后，那款游戏显示「已达到使用时限」。

examples.en: I saw "Time limit reached" when I tried to open the drawing app.
examples.zh: 我试着打开绘图应用时，看到了「已达到使用时限」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of time still available under an application's limit

examples.en: I checked my remaining app time before starting another video on the tablet.
examples.zh: 在平板上打开另一段视频前，我查看了「应用剩余使用时间」。

examples.en: The report showed remaining app time alongside my use of other apps.
examples.zh: 报告列出了「应用剩余使用时间」，也有其他应用的使用情况。

words.enDefinition: a recurring period during which the device restricts access to selected apps

examples.en: My iPhone began scheduled downtime while I was reading a printed chapter.
examples.zh: 我看纸质教材时，iPhone 进入了「定时停用时段」。

examples.en: I set scheduled downtime for the evenings before our early lab sessions.
examples.zh: 每次要上早间实验课的前一晚，我都开启了「定时停用时段」。

words.enDefinition: a notice that a scheduled period of restricted use is near

examples.en: I received a downtime reminder while saving the last slide on my iPad.
examples.zh: 我在 iPad 上保存最后一页幻灯片时，收到了「停用时段开始提醒」。

examples.en: The downtime reminder appeared before the scheduled restrictions began that night.
examples.zh: 那晚预定的限制开始前，出现了「停用时段开始提醒」。

words.enDefinition: Apple's setting for apps or contacts exempt from specified limits

examples.en: My course timetable was among the apps marked "Always Allowed" on my iPhone.
examples.zh: 在我的 iPhone 上，课程课表应用被标为「始终允许使用」。

examples.en: I checked "Always Allowed" before the evening restrictions started on my tablet.
examples.zh: 平板晚上的限制开始前，我看了看「始终允许使用」。

collocations: add an app to Always Allowed

words.enDefinition: an app icon shown less brightly to indicate restricted availability

examples.en: I noticed a dimmed app icon after my daily time allowance ran out.
examples.zh: 当天的使用额度用完后，我看到一个「变灰的应用图标」。

examples.en: The dimmed app icon reminded me that the game was paused for studying.
examples.zh: 这个「变灰的应用图标」提醒我，学习时那款游戏被暂停了。

words.enDefinition: a small symbol indicating a time-related limit or waiting period

examples.en: An hourglass icon appeared next to the apps restricted on my iPhone.
examples.zh: 我的 iPhone 上受限应用旁出现了一个「沙漏图标」。

examples.en: I asked why the hourglass icon was next to my game.
examples.zh: 我问为什么我的游戏旁边有个「沙漏图标」。

collocations: check the hourglass icon by an app

words.enDefinition: time set aside for studying without other activities interrupting it

examples.en: I booked a library room for some uninterrupted study time before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前，我订了间图书馆自习室，想留点「不受打扰的学习时间」。

examples.en: My phone stayed quiet throughout the uninterrupted study time I'd planned that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我那天下午安排的「不受打扰的学习时间」里，手机一直没响。

words.enDefinition: to place your phone with its screen facing the surface

examples.en: You can put your phone face down so incoming messages don't catch your eye.
examples.zh: 可以「把手机屏幕朝下放」，这样新来的消息就不会引开视线。

examples.en: One person suggested we put your phone face down during the timed practice exam.
examples.zh: 有个同学建议，做限时模拟考试时「把手机屏幕朝下放」。

collocations: remember to put your phone face down
decide to put your phone face down
put your phone face down while studying

words.expression: keep your phone out of reach
words.lemma: keep your phone out of reach
words.zhGloss: 把手机放在够不到的地方
words.enDefinition: to put your phone somewhere you cannot easily grab it
acceptedZhAnswers: 把手机放在够不到的地方
acceptedEnVariants: keep your phone out of reach

examples.en: It's easier to notice habits when you keep your phone out of reach for a while.
examples.zh: 暂时「把手机放在够不到的地方」，更容易留意自己的使用习惯。

examples.en: My classmate suggested we keep your phone out of reach during our shared reading hour.
examples.zh: 同学建议，共同阅读的那一小时里「把手机放在够不到的地方」。

collocations: choose to keep your phone out of reach
try to keep your phone out of reach
keep your phone out of reach while reading

words.enDefinition: to stop less important alerts from making a sound

examples.en: I decided to silence nonessential alerts while keeping reminders from my calendar.
examples.zh: 我决定「静音非必要提醒」，但保留日历提醒。

examples.en: Can we set the tablet to silence nonessential alerts during our practice?
examples.zh: 练习期间，能把平板设成「静音非必要提醒」吗？

words.enDefinition: to review several alerts together instead of checking each immediately

examples.en: I try to check notifications in batches between my morning and afternoon classes.
examples.zh: 我尽量在上午和下午的课之间「集中查看通知」。

examples.en: My roommate likes to check notifications in batches after finishing a chapter of reading.
examples.zh: 室友喜欢读完一章以后再「集中查看通知」。

collocations: choose to check notifications in batches
prefer to check notifications in batches
remember to check notifications in batches

words.enDefinition: to review alerts that arrived while you were doing something else

examples.en: I went outside to catch up on notifications after the study room closed.
examples.zh: 自习室关门后，我走到外面「补看未读通知」。

examples.en: My classmate needed to catch up on notifications after a long laboratory session.
examples.zh: 同学上了很久的实验课，需要「补看未读通知」。

collocations: time to catch up on notifications
need to catch up on notifications
pause to catch up on notifications

words.enDefinition: to fail to see, hear, or notice an incoming alert

examples.en: I worried I would miss an alert about the room change again.
examples.zh: 我担心自己又会「漏看一条提醒」，没看到教室改了。

examples.en: It was easy to miss an alert with my headphones still on.
examples.zh: 还还戴着耳机时，很容易「漏掉一条提醒」。

collocations: worry that you'll miss an alert

words.enDefinition: the feeling of having too many alerts to deal with

examples.en: I felt notification overload after being added to several new class groups.
examples.zh: 加入好几个新班级群后，我感到了「通知过多带来的负担」。

examples.en: Changing the way alerts were grouped reduced my notification overload that week.
examples.zh: 那周改了通知分组方式后，「通知过多带来的负担」减轻了。

words.enDefinition: a period deliberately spent away from phones or other screens

examples.en: I set aside screen-free time to read on paper after dinner.
examples.zh: 我晚饭后安排了「不看屏幕的时间」，读纸质书。

examples.en: We had some screen-free time while walking to the study centre.
examples.zh: 我们走去学习中心的路上，有一小段「不看屏幕的时间」。

words.enDefinition: to stop looking at a screen for a short period

examples.en: My tablet reminded me to take a screen break between two practice exercises.
examples.zh: 两道练习之间，平板提醒我「暂时离开屏幕」。

examples.en: I planned to take a screen break before reading the next set of slides.
examples.zh: 看下一组幻灯片之前，我打算「暂时离开屏幕」歇一会儿。

collocations: choose to take a screen break
time to take a screen break
want to take a screen break

words.enDefinition: a short pause to get up and stretch your body

examples.en: Our group took a stretch break after the timed reading exercise.
examples.zh: 做完限时阅读练习后，我们小组「起身活动了一小会儿」。

examples.en: The study app offered a stretch break between two longer sessions.
examples.zh: 学习应用在两个较长的时段之间安排了一次「起身活动的短休」。

words.enDefinition: a device alert prompting you to pause what you are doing

examples.en: A break reminder appeared while I was editing my presentation notes.
examples.zh: 我在改展示笔记时，弹出了一条「休息提醒」。

examples.en: I set a break reminder so I would pause after reviewing the chapter.
examples.zh: 我设了「休息提醒」，复习完那一章就停一会儿。

words.enDefinition: a timer that measures the length of a planned pause

examples.en: I started a break timer before going out for some water.
examples.zh: 我出去喝点水之前，开启了「休息计时器」。

examples.en: The break timer rang while we were walking back to our desks.
examples.zh: 我们往各自桌子走时，「休息计时器」响了。

words.enDefinition: to continue a timed period of focus after pausing it

examples.en: I tapped to resume the focus session after answering the door of our study room.
examples.zh: 我去开了自习室门，回来后点了「继续专注时段」。

examples.en: The app asked if I wanted to resume the focus session after the break.
examples.zh: 休息结束后，应用问我是否想「继续专注时段」。

collocations: choose to resume the focus session
tap to resume the focus session
want to resume the focus session

words.enDefinition: to stop a timer temporarily without resetting its elapsed time

examples.en: I had to pause the timer when my tutor asked a question.
examples.zh: 导师提问时，我得「暂停计时器」。

examples.en: We agreed to pause the timer while another student found the handout.
examples.zh: 另一名同学找讲义时，我们同意先「暂停计时器」。

words.enDefinition: a timer alternating periods of focused work and short breaks

examples.en: I tried a Pomodoro timer as I worked through my reading list.
examples.zh: 我按阅读清单读材料时，试用了「番茄钟计时器」。

examples.en: Our study group used a Pomodoro timer during the library session.
examples.zh: 我们学习小组在图书馆自习时用了「番茄钟计时器」。

words.enDefinition: a period reserved in a schedule for a studying task

examples.en: I started a study block before opening the practice questions online.
examples.zh: 在网上打开练习题前，我进入了「一段专门学习的时间」。

examples.en: My calendar labels the hour after lunch as a study block.
examples.zh: 我的日历把午饭后一小时标为「一段专门学习的时间」。

words.enDefinition: a record of previous sessions completed using a focus tool

examples.en: I checked my focus history to see which study sessions I'd completed.
examples.zh: 我查看「专注时段历史」，看自己完成了哪些自习时段。

examples.en: The timer saved all my previous sessions in its focus history.
examples.zh: 计时器把我以前的所有时段都保存在「专注时段历史」中。

words.enDefinition: a target for time spent focusing on tasks each day

examples.en: I set a daily focus goal for the week before my final exams.
examples.zh: 期末考试前一周，我设定了「每日专注目标」。

examples.en: The app showed that I had reached my daily focus goal that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，应用显示我已经达到了「每日专注目标」。

words.enDefinition: the number of successive days someone meets a study goal

examples.en: The app showed my study streak after I finished the day's reading.
examples.zh: 我读完当天的材料后，应用显示了「连续学习天数」。

examples.en: I didn't worry about breaking my study streak during the field trip.
examples.zh: 实地考察期间，我不担心自己的「连续学习天数」记录会中断。

words.enDefinition: a personal target for how much screen use is acceptable daily

examples.en: I set a daily screen time goal that still made room for online classes.
examples.zh: 我设了「每日屏幕时长目标」，同时给网课留了时间。

examples.en: My daily screen time goal changed after I began reading more material on paper.
examples.zh: 开始更多地读纸质材料后，我的「每日屏幕时长目标」也改了。

collocations: set a daily screen time goal
track a daily screen time goal
review a daily screen time goal

words.enDefinition: a period when someone voluntarily avoids using digital devices or services

examples.en: I tried a digital detox during a weekend spent with my cousins.
examples.zh: 和表亲一起过周末时，我试了试「暂时远离电子设备」。

examples.en: My classmate called her day away from social media a digital detox.
examples.zh: 同学把不看社交媒体的一天称为「暂时远离电子设备」。

words.enDefinition: scrolling through online content without paying much attention or having a purpose

examples.en: I noticed some mindless scrolling after finishing a difficult practice question.
examples.zh: 做完一道难练习题后，我发现自己在「漫无目的地刷屏」。

examples.en: My usage report made me think about mindless scrolling between classes.
examples.zh: 使用报告让我想起课间「漫无目的地刷屏」的情况。

words.expression: pick up your phone out of habit
words.lemma: pick up your phone out of habit
words.enDefinition: to reach for your phone automatically without having a particular reason
acceptedEnVariants: pick up your phone out of habit

examples.en: It's easy to pick up your phone out of habit when an online lecture stops briefly.
examples.zh: 网课短暂停下来时，很容易「习惯性拿起手机」。

examples.en: You might pick up your phone out of habit even before checking what time it is.
examples.zh: 你可能还没想看时间，就已经「习惯性拿起手机」了。

collocations: tend to pick up your phone out of habit
often pick up your phone out of habit
notice you pick up your phone out of habit

words.enDefinition: a warning or notification given through a sound you can hear

examples.en: I heard an audible alert from the tablet beside my notes.
examples.zh: 我听见笔记旁边的平板发出「声音提醒」。

examples.en: The timer played an audible alert at the end of each session.
examples.zh: 每个时段结束后，计时器都播放「声音提醒」。

words.enDefinition: a visible signal that draws attention without relying on sound

examples.en: I noticed a visual alert on the screen while wearing headphones.
examples.zh: 我戴着耳机时，注意到屏幕上有个「视觉提醒」。

examples.en: The tablet can show a visual alert instead of playing a sound.
examples.zh: 平板可以显示「视觉提醒」，不用播放提示音。

words.enDefinition: alerts that use a blinking light or screen to signal arrival

examples.en: My Android phone offered flash notifications for times when sound wasn't useful.
examples.zh: 我的 Android 手机可以用「闪光通知」，适合提示音不方便的情况。

examples.en: I tested flash notifications before using the device in our editing room.
examples.zh: 在剪辑室用这台设备之前，我测试了「闪光通知」。

words.enDefinition: an alert signalled by a brief change in screen brightness or colour

examples.en: I saw a screen flash before checking the change to my timetable.
examples.zh: 查看课表变更前，我看到了「屏幕闪光提醒」。

examples.en: The tablet used screen flash as its visual signal during the test.
examples.zh: 测试时，平板用「屏幕闪光提醒」作为视觉信号。

words.enDefinition: an alert signalled by the camera light flashing on a device

examples.en: I saw the camera flash alert when a message reached my Android phone.
examples.zh: 我的 Android 手机收到消息时，我看到了「相机闪光灯提醒」。

examples.en: She turned off the camera flash alert before joining the film screening.
examples.zh: 她在去看电影放映前，关掉了「相机闪光灯提醒」。

words.enDefinition: a notification felt through a vibration or tap on a device

examples.en: I felt a haptic alert on my watch during the presentation.
examples.zh: 展示过程中，我感觉到手表上的「触觉提醒」。

examples.en: The timer ended with a haptic alert instead of a sound.
examples.zh: 计时结束时发出「触觉提醒」，没有声音。

words.enDefinition: a particular sequence of vibrations used for an alert

examples.en: I chose a different vibration pattern for changes to my timetable.
examples.zh: 我为课表变更提醒选了另一种「振动节奏」。

examples.en: The vibration pattern helped me tell my timer apart from incoming calls.
examples.zh: 「振动节奏」让我可以区分计时提醒和来电。

words.enDefinition: an Apple setting for reading incoming notifications aloud through supported devices

examples.en: I tried "Announce Notifications" with my headphones while packing for class.
examples.zh: 收拾东西准备上课时，我戴着耳机试了试「播报通知」。

examples.en: My iPhone showed which apps were included in "Announce Notifications".
examples.zh: 我的 iPhone 显示了哪些应用启用了「播报通知」。

words.enDefinition: the loudness of the sound made when a call arrives

examples.en: I checked the ringer volume as I walked toward the study room.
examples.zh: 走向自习室的时候，我查看了「来电铃声音量」。

examples.en: The ringer volume was still high after I lowered the music volume.
examples.zh: 我把音乐音量调低了，「来电铃声音量」还是很高。

words.enDefinition: the loudness of the sounds used for incoming alerts

examples.en: My tablet's notification volume was lower than the sound of the video.
examples.zh: 平板的「通知提示音量」比视频声音小。

examples.en: I lowered the notification volume before the group recording began.
examples.zh: 小组录音开始前，我调低了「通知提示音量」。

words.enDefinition: to give a vibration alert while sound is turned off

examples.en: I set my phone to vibrate on silent before the group workshop.
examples.zh: 小组工作坊开始前，我设置手机「静音时仍振动」。

examples.en: The device can vibrate on silent when an alert would otherwise make noise.
examples.zh: 设备可以「静音时仍振动」，本来会响的提醒就能靠振动提示。

collocations: set the phone to vibrate on silent
let the watch vibrate on silent
